app_info.subtitle: Hours, overtime & pay
app_info.description: Adds up work hours from clock-in and clock-out times with unpaid breaks, overnight shifts and rounding, applies weekly and daily overtime rules, computes gross pay at a given rate, and exports a printable PDF timesheet or CSV. Also totals and converts durations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes hours, overtime and pay from the supplied entries and renders PDF/CSV files on demand; nothing is stored or submitted anywhere.
justifications.open_world_justification: No network access; it does not connect to payroll or HR systems.

justifications.read_only_justification: Pure arithmetic on the supplied durations.
justifications.open_world_justification: No network access or external systems.

test_cases.description: Weekly timesheet with breaks and pay.
test_cases.user_prompt: Add up my hours: Mon 8:00-5:30, Tue 8:00-6:15, Wed 7:45-4:15, Thu 8-5, Fri 8:00-7:00, 30 min lunch each day except Tuesday which was 45, at $22.50 an hour, week of Sep 28 2026
test_cases.expected_output: A day-by-day table with regular and overtime hours (overtime beyond 40h/week), gross pay, and PDF/CSV download buttons.

test_cases.user_prompt: I worked 9am to 10pm with a 30 minute break on Oct 5 2026 in California at $30/hr. How much overtime and double time?
test_cases.expected_output: 12.5 hours split into 8 regular, 4 overtime and 0.5 double time with the pay for each.

test_cases.user_prompt: Night shift timesheet: Oct 1 10pm to 6am, Oct 2 10pm to 6:30am, 30 minute unpaid break each night
test_cases.expected_output: Each shift is counted across midnight (7.5h and 8h) with the correct total.

test_cases.user_prompt: Make a timesheet for Sam Rivera, Oct 5-9 2026, 8:03 to 16:52 every day, rounded to 15 minutes, no breaks
test_cases.expected_output: Each day rounds to 8:45 and the sheet shows the employee name; a printable PDF is offered.

test_cases.user_prompt: Add 7:45 + 8:15 + 1h 30m + 90 minutes and give me the total in decimal hours
test_cases.expected_output: Total 19:00 (19.0 hours) with each item converted.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for tax withholding or net pay.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: How much federal tax will be withheld from my $900 paycheck?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app is not invoked; it does not compute taxes or net pay.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for clock time arithmetic unrelated to work hours.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What time is it in Tokyo right now?

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for labor-law advice.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Is my employer allowed to deny me overtime pay in Texas?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: ChatGPT answers conversationally; no calculation is requested.
